title: A domain's questions
description: docs/questions.yaml in a domain folder: what was asked of the domain owner, each with a leaning; answered ones keep their id and point at the rules that record the answer (ADR 0016).

id.description: Any id without spaces, unique across the domain's rules, questions and drawing issues (Q-3).

session.description: The number of the log, docs/decisions/NN-<date>-<what>.md.

leaning.description: The default that is built unless the owner says otherwise.

options.description: When it is a trade-off: the options, each with what it does to the model.

status.description: open: waiting on the owner. answered: `answer` and `answeredBy` say what was decided. withdrawn: no longer asked; `answer` says why.

about.description: The rules it would change, so the rulebook shows the question beside them.

asked.description: The session it was asked in.

answer.description: What the owner said, in their words where they gave them.

answered.description: The session it was answered in.

answeredBy.description: The rules that record the answer.
